SD48-X01.name: The CreatorDragon Generator Dragon
SD48-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit, and you can pay one cost to summon a Saga Brave card from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
You can separate a Brave from a Grandwalker Nexus you control and brave it to this Spirit. When you've done so, this Spirit refreshes.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses braved to Saga Braves you control gain an extra Red symbol.

SD48-013.name: Grandraw
SD48-013.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit/Ultimate's (When Summoned) effect resolves]
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Main effect.

[Main]
Draw two cards. Also, by sending two cores from any of your Grandwalker Nexuses to the Void, draw a card.

SD48-X03.name: Grandwalker Brahma
SD48-X03.effect:
[Core Charge: (Ancient Dragon/Worldswalker/Avatar & Cost 3 or more) (God Arms & Brave)]
◆When you Summon/Advent a target Spirit/Brave, you can +1 core to this Nexus.
◆When this Nexus is deployed, if you do not control a Grandwalker Nexus with the same card name, you can send three cards from your decktop to the Trash. For each target card among them, +1 core to this Nexus.

2 [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) During this turn, this Nexus is also treated as a Spirit with [LV1][LV2] 5000 BP, and can only be destroyed by Grandwalker Nexuses.

[Grand Field] [LV2] (Your Attack Step)
While your Brave Spirit is attacking, the opponent can't end the Attack Step via effects.

SD48-014.name: Igneet Flame
SD48-014.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or less Spirit. By sending a core from any Red Grandwalker Nexus you control to the Void, instead, destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

SD48-008.name: The AncientDragonCaptain Solkattu
SD48-008.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. You can pay one cost to summon a Saga Brave card among them. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

SD48-007.name: The AncientDragophant Mammo-Raga
SD48-007.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you've done so, during this battle, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[During Brave] [LV2] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

SD48-011.name: The DivineGlove Gaundret
SD48-011.effect:
[LV1] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

SD48-012.name: The DivineRingStaff Riga-Shakti
SD48-012.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, refresh this Spirit.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Skill: 2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Send two cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh one of your Spirits.

SD48-004.name: The FirelanceDragon Teel-Maanam
SD48-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By destroying an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Give all your Spirits/Grandwalker Nexuses braved to Saga Braves: "(When Attacks) Destroy an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's."

SD48-005.name: The FourFistDragon Mudra
SD48-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can reveal a card from your decktop. If it's a Saga Brave card, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit. Add the revealed card to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Red Grandwalker Nexus.

SD48-X02.name: The GrandDeitySword Aramandi
SD48-X02.effect:
[During Spirit Brave] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate, and draw a card.

[During Nexus Brave] [Grand Field]
This Nexus' symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Yellow/Blue.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10786.name: The HermitDragon Shloka
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A10786.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, add a "Brahma" Nexus card, a "Generator", and a Saga Brave card to the Hand. Return any remaining cards to the deckbottom.

[LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to opposing effects, by discarding a card from your Hand, it remains on the Field, in the same condition.

SD48-003.name: The IronclawDragon Narti-Yadarni
SD48-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

SD48-006.name: The LavashotDragon Jatis-Waram
SD48-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit/Ultimate.

[LV2]
Your Spirits braved to Saga Braves can't be returned to the Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

SD48-009.name: The RoaringDragon Ma-Sheed -Humanoid Form-
SD48-009.effect:
Flash - [Advent: Ancient Dragon & Cost 4 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents)
Destroy an opposing 15000 BP or less Spirit. Effects of the Spirit destroyed by this effect can't activate.

[LV2] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
You can pay one cost to summon one of this Spirit's pre-Advent cards. When you've done so, draw a card.

SD48-010.name: The SwordanceDragonEmperor Ma-Zain -Humanoid Form-
SD48-010.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Destroy two opposing 12000 BP or less Spirits/Ultimates. For each Spirit/Ultimate destroyed by this effect, draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Ancient Dragon"/"Grandwalker" family Spirits are blocked, refresh that Spirit/Grandwalker Nexus.
